column1: # The release audit's fault-injection arms (lane verify-coverage-audit, 2026-10-21).
# tools/coverage_sabotage.py reads this file; its docstring is the contract.
# One arm per line, TAB separated: arm, patch, bindings (build script names), side (cpu | gpu | cpu+gpu:
# the side whose code carries the fault, tools/coverage_sabotage.py THE SIDES), lanes, why.
# An arm is CAUGHT when every lane named reads MOVED or REFUSED on its side on the build with the
# patch applied and its clean cell on the clean build of the same commit, and (a one-sided arm) every
# lane reads its clean cell on the other side (`coverage_sabotage.py check-sides`).
# 2026-10-31: multi-GPU verification retired (docs/TOMBSTONES.md MOJOLEARN_PAR_VERIFY). Eight arms named only par-*
# lanes and were dropped: coverage-core-msel_host_impl, coverage-core-shard_merge_device, coverage-ivf-index_arrays_impl,
# coverage-precise-core-shard_topk_merge_host, coverage-precise-bindings-parallel_mlp_apply; their patches stayed in the tree until 2026-11-23 (lane patch-recut):
# parallel_mlp_apply is re-registered below on neural-trainer-unfused. The msel_host_impl, msel_rebase_device,
# shard_topk_merge_device, shard_merge_device and ivf index_arrays_impl patches were deleted by patch-recut and are
# restored 2026-11-23 by lane verify-gaps as the five arms at the end of this table, on the one-device lanes
# forest-shard, neighbors-reference-shard and ivf-distributed (tools/identity_lanes/coverage.py): the drivers run on
# one device by default, so their merges are live product code. Multi-GPU verification stays retired.
# targets (training/mlp_ops.mojo and the host MLP primitives are deleted; ParallelNeuralTrainer and SmallMLPTrainer run the
# trainer's captured program, covered by the executor arms); their patches are deleted (recoverable at 0ce88411d3).

column6: Every float64 output of nsum, row_means, fsum, row_stds and class_ratio is one ulp off, ragged_rows_bytes and shard_topk_merge_f32 are faulted too; GridSearchCV's mean_test_score comes from row_means_f64 and AdaBoost scales its votes by fsum_f64. trees-adaboost-reg is not named: AdaBoost.R2 predicts by the weighted median and calls none of these helpers (unmoved on Metal and the host column, 2026-10-21). Re-cut (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0003 core-1: both lanes unmoved on both columns while _mojolearn and _mojolearn_core_host changed): GridSearchCV's row_means_f64 / row_stds_f64 run in bindings/msel_search_stats_run.mojo:19, compiled into _mojolearn_runtime_model_selection_host (model_selection_native_call), which the arm did not rebuild, so build_runtime_model_selection_host joins the arm. trees-adaboost-clf left it: SAMME now runs in the x_trees glue (xt_samme_step, bindings/trees_public_boost_door.mojo), and the door's fsum_f64 helper _fsum had no caller (deleted with its fsum_f64 trees-helper entry). Lane w3f7-b, 2026-11-24: x-metrics-search read unmoved at f200804327: its GridSearchCV over a GBDT regressor takes mean_test_score from msel_row_means in core/msel_search_run.mojo, compiled into the trees bindings (runtime_trees_host, x_trees_host; x_trees on the GPU side), which this arm did not rebuild; they are added.

fold_ids swaps the fold ids of the first and last rows and mask_from_indices_u8 flips every mask byte; cross_val_score folds MOVE, and LeavePOut's indexed fill (bindings/msel_split_plan_run.mojo:884-889) refuses by name ('a split's test rows are not distinct') because the flipped mask counts n - size rows: a committed review. On the device column fold_ids and mask_from_indices_u8 run as device_kfold_ids / device_stratified_fold_ids / device_mask_from_indices_u8 (core/msel_helpers_device.mojo:85-96, 146), so this arm is the CPU column and coverage-core-device_fold_mask is its device twin. Host run 0be19c4f42 core-5 (after 0ad5ee9be9 declared the groups): cross-val and x-lasso-cv MOVED, x-metrics-splitters REFUSED with no review; the review closes it. Lane w3-fix-e (2026-11-23): x-lasso-cv no longer named (unmoved in the w3-integrate gate at b7ee615c96): LassoCV's integer cv no longer calls fold_ids; since lane mf-split5 both its door (bindings/x_linear_cv_unpack.mojo) and its member (core/xlinear_member.mojo _enetcv_fit) build KFold's fold ids in x_linear/cv_fold_ids_run.mojo xl_kfold_ids_f32_run, which arm coverage-x_linear-cv_fold_ids_run faults on x-lasso-cv. build_runtime_linear_host dropped with it (it was declared for x-lasso-cv's door). 2026-11-24 lane vdv-sabotage: cross-val-folds added (model_selection.default_folds and split_descriptor, the arm-less endpoints of the inventory, read these fold ids on the CPU side; the GPU side is coverage-gate-core-fold_ids-gpu).

lane w3-fix-e (2026-11-23): xl_kfold_ids_f32_run (x_linear/cv_fold_ids_run.mojo) swaps the fold ids of row 0 and the last row after the fill, a permutation that keeps every fold's size. It is the one body of LassoCV / ElasticNetCV's integer cv on both routes (the door, bindings/x_linear_cv_unpack.mojo `_xl_kfold_ids_f32`, built into _mojolearn_runtime_linear_host; the member, core/xlinear_member.mojo `_enetcv_fit`, in the host member bindings), so LassoCV(cv=3)'s mse_path_, alpha_ and coefficients in x-lasso-cv MOVE. The three host bindings whose closure holds the file are declared so the arm holds whichever route the lane loads; the CPU column (the device column has no device fold body for an integer cv).

lane sab-gpu-missed (2026-11-23), the device twin of coverage-core-hotpath_impl: device_kfold_ids swaps the fold ids of row 0 and the last row and device_mask_from_indices_u8 swaps the mask bytes of row 0 and the last row (core/hotpath_device.mojo), the bodies the GPU base binding's model-selection helper table runs for KFold folds and index masks (core/msel_helpers_device.mojo:85, 146); cross_val_score and the splitters read them on the device column. Lane w3-fix-e (2026-11-23): x-lasso-cv no longer named: LassoCV's integer cv folds come from the host body x_linear/cv_fold_ids_run.mojo on every column (lane mf-split5), never from device_kfold_ids; coverage-x_linear-cv_fold_ids_run covers them. Lane sab-gpu-missed-2 (2026-11-24; L40S run on 4519097d38, batch core-3): the bit flip complemented every test mask, so the splitters' distinct-rows check (bindings/msel_split_plan_run.mojo:1065) refused before any digest; the swap keeps the set count, so LeavePOut's test rows move instead.

Test-fold labels 0 and 1 swapped in assign_fold_i64 (count_fold_hits_i64 keeps the true label, so TargetEncoder's cv=<splitter> check refuses by name, bindings/prep_encode_native_door.mojo:2521-2525: a committed review), fold labels swapped in the stratified and group fold planners, init draws one ulp off, scattered rows swapped; StratifiedKFold/GroupKFold, the MLP weight init and TargetEncoder reach them. The splitters run in _mojolearn_runtime_model_selection_host (bindings/msel_split_door.mojo) and TargetEncoder's user folds in _mojolearn_runtime_prep_host (bindings/prep_encode_native_door.mojo:72, 2508, 2523). sequence-mlp is coverage-core-hotpath_impl_rows-mlp-init (CPU) and coverage-core-device_uniform_init (device). Host run 0be19c4f42 core-6 BUILD-FAIL was a box event (runtime_prep_host failed with no compiler text at 23:18:38Z with the run's three other BUILD-FAILs; the same patched file compiled rc=0 in build_core_host and build_runtime_model_selection_host of the same batch): the patch is unchanged. Lane w3-fix-e (2026-11-23): on the host column x-metrics-splitters REFUSED (w3-integrate gate at b7ee615c96) because two faults broke the splitters' own count invariants: bincount2_i32 counted row 0 twice (StratifiedGroupKFold's group table summed to n + 1, so select_fold_i64 disagreed with the group counts, bindings/msel_split_plan_run.mojo:1085-1098) and first_seen_i32 swapped the codes of rows 0 and n - 1 without their class counts. Both are now consistent faults: bincount2_i32 counts row 0 under the next class of its group (every group total kept) and first_seen_i32 exchanges codes 0 and 1 with their counts, so StratifiedKFold, StratifiedShuffleSplit, train_test_split(stratify) and StratifiedGroupKFold MOVE instead of refusing; the device column (Metal MOVED) runs the device twins. The x-prep-user-objects review is re-bound to the new patch bytes.

lane sab-gpu-missed (2026-11-23), the CPU column of coverage-core-hotpath_impl_rows's init fault: uniform_init_f32 draws one ulp off, and the sklearn-shaped MLPs of sequence-mlp take their initial weights from it on the CPU column (sequence/model_outputs_host.mojo -> sequence/model_output_fallback.mojo:22, built into _mojolearn_x_sequence_host), so every trained weight and prediction moves.

lane sab-gpu-missed (2026-11-23), the device twin of coverage-core-hotpath_impl_rows-mlp-init: device_uniform_init_f32 (core/hotpath_device.mojo) returns its first initial weight one ulp off; on the device column the MLPs of sequence-mlp draw their initial weights there (sequence/model_outputs_device.mojo:60, built into _mojolearn_x_sequence), so every trained weight and prediction moves.

argmax winners stepped within range, gathers rotated by one, casts one ulp off; rf-clf/et-clf predict runs argmax_rows then decode_labels (gather_i64) on the CPU column and AutoARIMA's search gathers series rows.

nonzero_f64_fill stores every COO affinity weight as 1.0 (edges and symmetry kept, weights lost); SpectralClustering(affinity=precomputed) on the CPU column builds its COO through the core host's SpectralPreparationHost.fill_wide (core/spectral_preparation_host.mojo:20, bindings/cfb_spectral_door.mojo:398-400), so labels_ and predict move. Re-cut (lane sab-host-missed-cls, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 core-2: both lanes unmoved): the one-ulp weight was masked by the discrete labels (the lane hashes the input affinity, labels_ and predict labels only); transpose_to_f32 has no product caller (its only callers are the core host transpose_f32 / cast_colmajor_f64_to_f32 exports, which no public operation reaches), so its hunk and elasticnet are dropped.
narrow_w64 flips the low bit of every class item (labels 0/1 become 1/0), so Sequential's classes_, the exported file and predict move on both columns.
label_sort_key flips the low bit of every key, permuting classes and codes together; RNNClassifier's and Sequential's training targets change, so loss, params and proba move.

qn_link_from_device (the device predict_proba link: LogisticRegression.predict_proba -> core/logistic_member.mojo _proba -> QN_NATIVE_PROBA -> glm/logistic_native_device.mojo QnDeviceKernels.query) steps every downloaded float64 probability one ulp; both lanes hash predict_proba (GPU column). Re-cut 2026-11-23 (lane sab-missed-5): the old patch faulted qn_sigmoid_device/qn_softmax_device, which no device path called (deleted). Lanes added by vdv-sab2-a (2026-11-24): public-randomized-search: its classifier part hashes LogisticRegression.predict_proba.
host_grove_forest_from steps every leaf value of the resident host snapshot one ulp; both lanes set inference_engine="parallel_groves", so predict moves on the CPU column.
Every exported threshold and leaf is one ulp off, as is the transposed X; predict, proba and the model hash move on the CPU column.

Every exported threshold and leaf is one ulp off; the resident forest and the saved model are built from those arrays (device column). Lanes added by vdv-sab2-a (2026-11-24): saved-model-host-infer-trees, trees-shap-tree, trees-shap-kernel, trees-adaboost-clf-methods, generic-attrs-trees, generic-digest-trees: the exported thresholds and leaves feed the saved model (GPU and host read the same faulted leaves), TreeSHAP and KernelSHAP over the members, and AdaBoost's decision_function. the generic trees-group lanes read the fitted forests whose exported thresholds and leaves this arm faults.
The host gather writes every component one ulp off and swaps the first two core indices; DBSCAN.save writes both, so the model column moves (CPU column).

resample_store_indices swaps the first two indices; resample-utils hashes resample_indices' output on both columns. w3-fix-9-s3 (2026-11-25): fn-resample-indices (resample_indices) and fn-resample-resample (resample in identical mode: resample_rows_indices, op RS_OP_RESAMPLE_INDICES; the GPU gather route is fast-only, resample/estimator.mojo:2339) read the same swapped indices on both columns.

Sha256.digest_words flips the low bit of all eight digest words, so every digest moves, including the payload_sha256 the saved MLP and byte-LM files carry (model column). Bindings (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0003 byte_lm-1 unmoved on both columns): the payload_sha256 of the saved MLP is computed in bindings/small_mlp_native_door.mojo:1124 (small_mlp_call, _mojolearn_runtime_parallel_host) and the byte-LM's in providers/python/byte_lm_json_checkpoint_pyapi_door.mojo:93 (_mojolearn_runtime_byte_trainer_host); each binary carries its own Sha256, so both runtime hosts join the arm.
The device dbscan_core_gather writes every component one ulp off and swaps the first two core indices; DBSCAN.save writes both (device column).
from_f16_device steps every widened float32 word up one ulp after the device copy-back, and the lane hashes widen_f16 over all 65536 f16 patterns (GPU column).

cholesky_solve_host_run and from_f16_host_run store every output one ulp off, and these lanes hash solve() / solve_cholesky and widen_f16 through the linalg host binding. par-cholesky is not named: it reads N/A on the host column (no CPU driver), so it never loads this host binding.

gp_theta_params_values steps each float32 kernel value one ulp before widening, and log_marginal_likelihood(theta) builds the kernel from those values, so the hashed lml and gradients move (GPU column).
The same fault in gp_theta_params_list, which the host binding's gp_theta_params calls, so the CPU column's lml and grad parts move.

gbdt_host_binary_prediction_into steps the positive probability one ulp and flips every 0/1 class code, and GradientBoostingClassifier predict, predict_proba and score (via _binary_output) are hashed.

prediction_data_host_run stores every cluster death one ulp off, and the approximate_predict probabilities and membership vectors these lanes hash read the deaths. par-hdbscan is not named: it reads N/A on the host column (no CPU driver), so it never loads this host binding.
The same deaths fault in prediction_data_door_run (GPU column).
kmh_rbf_sampler_fit_into stores every weight and offset one ulp off, and the lane hashes random_weights_, random_offset_ and transform.
binary_ranking_checked returns every AUC and curve value one ulp off, and the lane hashes the unweighted binary roc_auc_score and precision_recall_curve, which call this host entry.

out_f32_to steps every word one ulp after either copy arm (GPU filter_topk distances), and out_i32_to swaps the first two words, which moves the hashed CAGRA graph on both columns; an array that starts at 0 (offsets) is left alone.

verify_digest flips the low bit of every digest and verify_fill puts every seeded float32 one ulp off; these lanes hash every part through verify_digest and tape-program fills its weights with verify_fill.
prophet_days puts every day value one float64 ulp off (order kept) and prophet_changepoints every scaled changepoint one float32 ulp off, which moves params_ and the forecasts the lane hashes.

lamb_offsets moves the first tensor boundary one value later while the flat n stays the same, so every per-tensor norm and trust ratio of the non-resident lamb_step moves. (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0004 x_sequence-1: unmoved on the device column): the resident LAMB route admitted its offsets with its own copy (sequence/opt_resident.mojo _lamb_offsets); it now calls lamb_offsets, so the fault reaches the device column.
opt_resident_move puts every state value one ulp off in both directions and lamb_resident_open fills exp_avg with 1.0, so the hashed optimizer state moves (GPU column).
onnx_read puts every float32 initializer value one ulp off in the bytes the reader keeps and every finite float attribute one float32 ulp off, so the imported program's outputs move.
ovo_dual_gemv_host puts every coef_ value one ulp off, and the lane hashes the linear multiclass coef_.

Epilogue decisions and probabilities, C rows, fold-finish decisions and Platt (A, B) one ulp off, class codes stepped within range, gathered, selected, fold and shuffle indices swapped first and last.
device_platt_train writes (A, B) one float64 ulp off and device_splitmix_perm swaps the first and last shuffle entries, so probA_, probB_ and the probabilities move (GPU column).
ovo_dual_gemv_device puts every coef_ value one ulp off after the download, and the lane hashes coef_ (GPU column).

parse_rank_table flips the low bit of every token byte (a bijection, so no duplicate-key refusal), which moves the ranks text, identity and ids of every tokenizer loaded with from_ranks_file. Bindings (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23): build_tokenizer_fast left the arm. Its script builds only on macOS ("the FAST tokenizer device path is Apple only", rc=2 in 1 s on the L40S, nvc1-0003 tokenizer-1, which failed the whole batch), and both lanes run in identical mode, which never loads the fast binary; the fault reaches them through build_tokenizer_host. Bindings (sub-lane tok, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 tokenizer-3: tokenized-corpus unmoved): lm_corpus.prepare is lm_corpus_public_call, routed to _mojolearn_runtime_catalog_host; the second prepare reloads the cached ranks.tsv (bindings/lm_corpus_prepare_run.mojo:304 bpe_handle_load -> load_rank_table -> parse_rank_table), whose flipped bytes no longer hash to the identity vocabulary.json pins, so it refuses at lm_corpus_prepare_run.mojo:308: reviewed, the fault's real effect. 2026-11-24 lane vdv-sabotage: side cpu+gpu: the tokenizer host binding is the native router both sides of one GPU process call (optimizer_native, the parameter glue, safetensors and the tokenizer run there for device='gpu' too), so the fault sits in code both sides run.

Every function that writes a value is faulted (ids swapped, byte low bits flipped, every decoded sequence after the first in a batch flipped), so encode, decode, the trained vocabulary and the corpus rows move. Review (sub-lane tok, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 tokenizer-4: tokenized-corpus REFUSED): the second prepare reloads the cached ranks.tsv through the faulted bpe_handle_load (ids 0 and 1 trade tokens), so ranks_text no longer hashes to the identity vocabulary.json pins and bindings/lm_corpus_prepare_run.mojo:308 refuses; that refusal is reviewed as the fault's real effect. 2026-11-24 lane vdv-sabotage: side cpu+gpu: the tokenizer host binding is the native router both sides of one GPU process call (optimizer_native, the parameter glue, safetensors and the tokenizer run there for device='gpu' too), so the fault sits in code both sides run.
csr_checked_device swaps the column of the first and last edge in the CSR block spmm uses (GPU column).
On the CPU column out_f32 puts every returned word one ulp up (gather_rows_f32, faulted before, was deleted from the product in 5f8eaad629; x_cnn_res_argmax went with lane x8b).
kfeat_pcs_draw_idn steps every indexHash_ entry to (v+1) mod n_components, and kfeat_schi2_fit_idn puts every random_weights_/random_offset_ word one ulp up, the IDENTICAL draws both lanes hash.

On the host column the 1-D MinCovDet runs order_f, argmin_all, select_smallest and move, ALS recommend runs topn_desc and gather, and the qr/svd of x-decomp-lu runs r_signs and rank_above; each output is swapped, stepped or one ulp off. Bindings (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0004 x_decomp-2: robust-cov and als unmoved on the device column): x_decomp/api.mojo is also compiled into _mojolearn_runtime_decomp_host (the decomp doors, mcd_native_call / als_native_call), which the arm did not rebuild; it joins the arm. Lane sab-gpu-missed-2 (2026-11-24; L40S x_decomp-2 on 4519097d38: CAUGHT on cpu, robust-cov and als unmoved on device): on the device column DKit routes every resident operand to the XD_DEV_* entries (bindings/decomp_kit_run.mojo:994 argmin_all, :1005 select_smallest, als_run.mojo:96 order_dev), the select_dev.mojo kernels that coverage-x_decomp-select_dev faults; these host entries never run there, so this arm is the host column only and x-decomp-lu's device move is kept by coverage-x_decomp-api-lu.

Lane sab-gpu-missed-2 (2026-11-24): the coverage_api patch's r_signs and rank_above hunks, which the qr/svd of x-decomp-lu runs on the host AND the device column (L40S x_decomp-2 on 4519097d38: x-decomp-lu MOVED on both); split from coverage-x_decomp-api, whose other hunks are host-only.

The rank-deficient randomized_svd compacts Q through order_small on the host column; its first and last entries are swapped, so a live column is dropped. x-decomp-rsvd-rank-deficient is the lane whose sketch is wider than its matrix's rank (x-decomp-lstsq-rsvd never reaches the compaction: unmoved on Metal and the host column, 2026-10-21). The reduce_run hunk (a max one ulp off) feeds only NaN refusals and cutoffs, which no digest sees. Bindings (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0004 x_decomp-6: unmoved on the device column): randomized_svd's door (bindings/linalg_decomp_run.mojo ld_rsvd_run) and select_ops.mojo are compiled into _mojolearn_runtime_decomp_host, which the arm did not rebuild; it joins the arm. Lane sab-gpu-missed-2 (2026-11-24; L40S x_decomp-6 on 4519097d38: CAUGHT on cpu, unmoved on device): the device rsvd compacts through dev_order_small_run (x_decomp/pca_randomized_dev.mojo:112, select_dev.mojo order_small_kernel), never order_small_run, so this arm is the host column only; the device column is coverage-x_decomp-select_dev (its order_small swap, lane x-decomp-rsvd-rank-deficient).

On the device column the 1-D MinCovDet's order, argmin, select and reduce, the rsvd's order_small and LLE's dsum_sq are swapped or one ulp off. Lane sab-gpu-missed-2 (2026-11-24): x-decomp-als joins: ALS recommend on the device column orders the score row through kit.order_dev (bindings/als_run.mojo:96 -> XD_DEV_ORDER -> dev_order_f_run), whose first two positions this patch swaps, so the recommended ids move (the host twin is coverage-x_decomp-api).

Every resident fit on the GPU binding uploads through dev_upload, reads back through dev_download and copies through dev_move, all now one ulp off. robust-cov and factor-analysis MOVE; manifold's Isomap(radius).transform admission REFUSES (review committed in tools/identity_lanes/coverage_sabotage_reviews.json).
Isomap and LLE build their graphs with graph_knn, graph_knn_dense, graph_radius, graph_lle_iw and graph_join, all one ulp off, on the host column.
The device graph builders write their edges one ulp off and dev_graph_components swaps its first two labels (GPU column).
ivf_out_of_bounds_distance returns the largest finite float32 instead of +inf, and every ivf-short-fill query pads past its candidates with it (host column).

upload, download and copy put every value one ulp off and alloc zero fill becomes the smallest normal, and sequence-device-tensor steps RMSprop over resident params and round-trips a tensor (GPU column).

column1: # lane verify-coverage-owed (2026-10-21): the arms the audit left owed to the migration lanes.

column6: rows_call swaps the two probability modes (SGDClassifier's normalized sigmoids and LogisticRegressionCV's sigmoid/softmax) and halves the Huber threshold, so outliers_ and both predict_proba tables move; the estimators bindings compile the same rows_call and call it only for ROWS_LOG and ROWS_SQRT_F32, which the fault leaves alone. Re-cut (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0004 x_linear-1 unmoved on both columns): the old patch faulted rows_call, which x_linear never calls (x_linear/x_linear_host_impl.mojo and x_linear/device.mojo run rows_one / rows_kernel directly); the patch now swaps the two probability modes and halves the Huber threshold inside rows_one, the body both columns run.

seq_optimizer_init starts the step count at 1, export_copy writes the state slots in reverse and import_copy loads the step count one ahead; the bias-corrected optimizers' steps, the exported state and the resumed steps move on both columns.

the CNNClassifier forward (sequence/cnn_classifier_program.mojo _forward, the captured program Program.fit trains and the resident predict session replays, on the device and the host column) passes the head logits through an extra ReLU, so every negative logit reads 0: the fit losses and trained weights and the predict / predict_proba outputs of the three CNNClassifier lanes move. Path: CNNClassifier.fit -> xcnn_native_call (_mojolearn_runtime_xseq_host, bindings/xcnn_native_pack.mojo:165) -> cnnclf_fit -> neural_descriptor_execute(CNN_FIT) on the x_sequence image's model_native_api_v1 (_native_xcnn_bridge.py:255-257; host column _mojolearn_x_sequence_host, sequence/model_host_dispatch.mojo:101; device sequence/model_device_dispatch.mojo:119) -> cnn_fit_program -> _forward. Re-cut 2026-11-23 (lane sab-host-missed-nrl; MISSED on both columns): _forward returns through the default CNN_FUSED_OPS branch (OPS_CNN_LINEAR; autograd/cnn_block_op.mojo:80) and the old patch faulted only the opt-in generic tail; the ReLU now follows both heads. Re-cut 2026-11-24 (lane ab2-nseq): the generic tail (MOJOLEARN_CNN_GENERIC_OPS) is deleted, so the ReLU follows the one head (OPS_CNN_LINEAR). Re-cut 2026-11-24 lane vdv-recut (context only).

resident_open fills a fresh slot's second moment with 1, and resident_download and resident_upload swap the two moments; the Samba stack's resident AdamW step, its state_dict moments and its load_state_dict resume move on a GPU column (the host binding opens no slot: it exports no optimizer_resident_step).

count_fold_hits_i64 reports one false overlap for a nonempty index list while assign_fold_i64 stays correct; TargetEncoder rejects the valid training/test partition. This independently faults both native registrations that the previous assign-only arm left untested. Re-cut (lane sab-gpu-missed, 2026-11-23; nvc1-0003 core-2 unmoved on both columns): TargetEncoder's fold checks ran on the door's own copies (bindings/prep_encode_prog_run.mojo enc_assign_fold_i64 / enc_check_train_i64, deleted) inside _mojolearn_runtime_prep_host; the door now calls the core bodies and build_runtime_prep_host joins the arm. The refusal is reviewed in coverage_sabotage_reviews.json.

_sequence_store (core/sequential_input_plan.mojo:207) stores every half of a sequence leaf one ulp off; the lane fits LinearRegression, Ridge, the scalers and PCA on a list of float16 rows, whose leaves sequence_write converts through _sequence_store (core/sequential_input_plan.mojo:273), and holds the OLS coefficients to the fit on the float16 ndarray, which takes no sequence plan: the byte oracle refuses ('ols coef_ from a list of float16 rows ... differ'), a committed review. All four groups compile core/sequential_input_plan.mojo (bindings/classical_arrays_door.mojo, bindings/sequential_inputs_door.mojo). Host run 0be19c4f42 runtime_classical-1 BUILD-FAIL was a box event (runtime_classical_host failed with no compiler text at 23:19:16Z with the run's three other BUILD-FAILs; the same patched file compiled rc=0 in the linear, prep and decomp hosts of the same batch): the patch is unchanged.

scaler_cast writes the first cast value one unit high; StandardScaler.fit on the lane's list of float16 rows casts the half matrix to float32 through it (providers/python/preprocessing_input_pyapi_door.mojo:136-140, taken only when the input is not float32 C-order), while the float32 ndarray fit skips scaler_cast, so the lane's byte oracle (tools/identity_lanes/coverage.py:1349) refuses: a committed review (host run 0be19c4f42 runtime_prep-1: REFUSED 7 bytes of 192).

mlp_read_f32 reads every training loss back one unit high; the lane hashes the three SmallMLPTrainer.train_step losses (`loss`). Bindings (sub-lane tok, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 tokenizer-3: mlp unmoved): core/small_mlp_state_impl.mojo is not in the import closure of _mojolearn_tokenizer_host at all; SmallMLPTrainer.train_step is small_mlp_call, routed by host_surface.py to _mojolearn_runtime_parallel_host, which reads the losses at bindings/small_mlp_native_door.mojo:706 (mlp_read_f32). build_tokenizer_host left the arm (its binary cannot change).

pca_check_state doubles the first validated singular_values_ word; the live whitened PCA transform consumes it and the lane hashes that result as wT. The former pca_widen_spectrum patch targeted an uncalled helper and MISSED on source243; that original failure remains retained.

registry_offsets moves every interior tensor boundary of the optimizer registry one float early; the clipped steps' per-tensor norms (the two-level clip fold over offsets) and the norms each lane hashes move. Bindings (lane sab-host-missed-nrl, 2026-11-23; MISSED on both columns at 0be19c4f42 with build_training,build_training_host): the registry is built once, at construction, by optimizer_prepare_registry (bindings/optimizer_public_door.mojo:596 -> training/optimizer_state_plan.mojo:87), whose only caller is optimizer_construct in bindings/optimizer_native_router_door.mojo:338, exported as optimizer_native by _mojolearn_tokenizer_host (bindings/_mojolearn_tokenizer_host.mojo:1085) and bound by the bridge (python/mojolearn/_native_optimizer_bridge.py:104-105); the step reads the stored offsets. So build_tokenizer_host is the build; build_training stays only so the device column runs the same lanes on the faulted registry.

host_slot negates the slot's first moment on every lookup; on the host column SGD with momentum steps through the host resident slot (public_step_host), so the momentum buffer and the parameters move.

causal_lm_gather_f32 negates and shifts the first gathered value; the lane builds CausalLM(plan, weights) with a column-major head, which the model gathers into C order, and hashes its logits (`gathered`). Bindings (sub-lane tok, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 tokenizer-6: hf-model-surface unmoved): CausalLM(plan, weights) is causal_model_init, routed by host_surface.py to _mojolearn_runtime_neural_host (bindings/causal_lm_construct_door.mojo:1237, which imports causal_lm_gather_f32 at :30); the tokenizer host only registers an unavailable stub for it (bindings/_mojolearn_tokenizer_host.mojo:1229). build_tokenizer_host left the arm.

minmax_fit_transform_direct reads the fitted min_ row as the scale, so MinMaxScaler.fit_transform's words move on the GPU column while fit then transform does not; scaler-fit-transform hashes both and their agreement.

_accumulate_out adds one to the first accumulated float on the host-pointer path every training.accumulate_grads call takes; grad-accumulation hashes the combined gradient. 2026-11-24 lane ogs-cpu: ordered-gradient-sum's GPU side (parallel_training.ordered_sum_gradients, device='gpu') folds through the same entry (op 9 accumulate, one [2, count] pair per shard step, the host-pointer path), so its total moves by one per step and the lane's left-fold oracle and digest move; its CPU side never calls it.

lane ogs-cpu (2026-11-24): ordered_gradient_sum_cpu (core/ordered_gradient_sum_host.mojo, the CPU fold of parallel_training.ordered_sum_gradients) adds one to the first folded total after the last step; only the device='cpu' side (and a CPU-only installation) runs it, so ordered-gradient-sum's CPU cell moves (its NumPy left-fold oracle and digest) and its GPU cell, folded by the GPU pair fold, stays put. The GPU twin is coverage-training-samba_accumulate_out.

lmhead_gp_leaf_body (the GEMM-panel profile, default since 2026-11-19; training/chunked_lm_head_panel_math.mojo) moves token 0's shifted logit by 1/16 in every row's denominator leaf, so the loss and both gradients move; training-chunked-lm-head hashes the loss and both gradients. Before 2026-11-19 the arm patched _device_logit of the scalar serial profile, which the default no longer runs.
_perm_gather_kernel doubles the first gathered value and _perm_inverse_kernel swaps the first two inverse positions in the device CSR views; x-cnn-gcn (edge-weighted GCN) hashes forward and backward.
perm_gather_host and vals_t_host double their first output value on the host column's CSR views; x-cnn-gcn (edge-weighted GCN forward and backward through the transposed weighted view) hashes them.

every scalar score the GPU metrics binding's host doors return (accuracy, rand, adjusted rand, entropy, mutual information, homogeneity, completeness, V-measure, Fowlkes-Mallows, R^2, KL, MSE/MAE/RMSE, log loss) moves by 1/128, and so do the three values of the fused homogeneity_completeness_v_measure_host entry (N356, bindings/mcls_cluster_door.mojo MCLS_OPN_FAMILY_MCLS_HCV; added 2026-11-23 by lane sab-missed-5: without it the scalar APIs moved and the fused entry did not, and metrics-homogeneity-completeness refused its cross-API check in nvc1-0003); the metrics lanes hash each score.

the GPU preprocessing binding's direct fits double the first scale_ word (minmax_fit_on, standard_fit_on: the bodies minmax_fit_direct / standard_fit_direct and the device member store, preprocessing/prep_member_store.mojo, share since vd-functions) and its direct transforms move the first output word (minmax_transform_on / standard_transform_on, standard fit_transform); the scaler lanes hash scale_ and the transforms. the linear fits' column sums (one ulp), centered and row-scaled cells, float32 means and intercept, and the OLS and multi-target ridge predictions move on the GPU binding and its host twin; the OLS, weighted OLS, ridge and multi-output ridge lanes hash coefficients, intercepts and predictions. _m3_session_export_run writes buffer_qrot and buffer_krot swapped; the lane's sync_state reads them through mamba3_session_export_state, and its in-cell byte oracle against the per-call state refuses by name (REFUSED, since no shared path exists to move both sides; the review is committed in tools/identity_lanes/coverage_sabotage_reviews.json and `coverage_sabotage.py review` binds it to each run).

_m3_session_copy_in loads buffer_qrot and buffer_krot swapped (a no-op on the zero state at open, live on the synced four-token state at load_state); the steps after mamba3_session_load_state then differ from the per-call steps and the lane's in-cell oracle refuses by name (REFUSED; review committed in tools/identity_lanes/coverage_sabotage_reviews.json, bound to each run by `coverage_sabotage.py review`).

_rf_classifier_fit/_rf_regressor_fit write forest.oob_score_ + 1e-9 into the requested score buffer, which only the aux entries (rf_*_fit_aux_export) pass; the lane's RF fits with oob_score=True digest oob_score_ (rf_oob, rfr_oob).

Reused: every threshold and leaf rf_export_trees_into copies out is one ulp off; the lanes' float64 Fortran-order fits take rf_classifier_fit_export/rf_regressor_fit_export and their colmajor parts predict from the exported arrays.

Reused: rf_export_trees_into's thresholds and leaves are one ulp off; class_weight/sample_weight fits (rf_classifier_fit_weighted_export, rf_regressor_fit_weighted_export, AdaBoost's weighted members) export through it and the lanes digest their predict_proba/predict.

pca_fit_host (the body of the pca_fit export and of the PCA owner's covariance arm, pca_fit_owned) publishes every explained_variance_ word scaled by 1 + 1e-6; PCA(n_components=4) with svd_solver 'auto' takes that arm on the device column and both lanes hash explained_variance_.

cross_vendor_fold (cross_vendor_call 'fold' and 'pair') leaves every added shard's last element out of the fold (re-cut 2026-11-24 lane vdv-recut onto the one ordered fold of vd-functions: the host-beside ordered_fold_f32 call and the base-image parallel_ordered_fold_f32 call both take n - 1), consistently for the whole and resumed folds, so the lane's fold, prefix and pair digests move. 2026-11-24 lane vdv-sabotage: side cpu+gpu: the tokenizer host binding is the native router both sides of one GPU process call (optimizer_native, the parameter glue, safetensors and the tokenizer run there for device='gpu' too), so the fault sits in code both sides run.

vocab_fingerprint_hex hashes one extra byte, so every vocabulary fingerprint moves (checkpoint and resume use the same faulted function and still agree); the lane hashes the checkpoint's tokenizer fingerprint. Bindings (sub-lane tok, 2026-11-23; host run 0be19c4f42 tokenizer-5: hf-causal-lm-text unmoved): the checkpoint's fingerprint is written by causal_lm_snapshot (stream.state_dict) at bindings/causal_lm_public_door.mojo:3910 (tokenizer_vocab_fingerprint -> vocab_fingerprint_hex), which host_surface.py routes to _mojolearn_runtime_neural_host; that group was never rebuilt. build_tokenizer_host left the arm: no hashed part of the lane takes the fingerprint through it.

The same mle_pick step on the host column: pca_mle_rank_host (x_decomp_pca_mle_rank's body, and estimators_host's pca_mle_rank_host_run) returns a neighboring valid rank, so PCA(n_components='mle') keeps a different count and the mle part moves.

log_softmax_kernel (xn_log_softmax) moves each row's first log-probability by 1e-6 relative plus 1e-6 absolute; NearestCentroid.predict_log_proba runs it on the device column and the lane hashes log_proba.

MselHostStore.put keeps its copy with the first byte's low bit flipped, so the resident fold snapshots model_selection._Resident puts through arena_msel_put (X, y and the int64 fold indices take_rows gathers by) change and x-metrics-search's cross_validate, cross_val_predict and GridSearchCV hashes move on the CPU column. csr_build_host permutes the CSR column array of both _Graph views (bindings/xcnn_graph_native_door.mojo _csr), so every GCN and SAGE aggregation gathers other neighbors and those lanes' outputs move on the CPU column.
